headline: Bitcoin Retreats Below Recent Highs Amid Tech Sector Volatility
summary: Bitcoin pulled back from its recent run toward $85,000, sliding back to key support levels as broader technology futures faced selling pressure.
why: Bitcoin is the largest digital asset by market capitalization, often trading in correlation with high-growth technology equities and broader risk appetite.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Broader risk-off sentiment in equity futures weighs on crypto derivatives and spot valuations.

why_moved: Spillovers from weaker tech futures and profit-taking led to a correction in cryptocurrency markets from intraday highs.
